MemoriaHub CLI v1.4.0
Usage: memoriahub node service [options] [command]

Manage the systemd user service that keeps the worker node always on

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  install         Write ~/.config/systemd/user/memoriahub-node.service and
                  enable it now
  uninstall       Stop, disable, and remove the systemd user service
  status          Show systemd status for the worker-node service
  help [command]  display help for command
